about: Announced openings that are NOT open yet (restaurants, cafés & bars, coffee, bakeries). Shown on the site under New → Opening soon. expectedOpening = YYYY-MM-DD | YYYY-MM | YYYY | "soon"; once that date/period has passed (Europe/Brussels, computed in the browser) the record shows as "Just opened" until it is moved into brugge.json (see update.md). Unknown fields are null; nothing invented. `opening: 'YYYY-MM'` is accepted as an alias of expectedOpening. Cards show 'Opening soon · <Month>' (year added beyond the next 3 months); once the month has passed the place shows as 'New since <Month YYYY>' automatically.
